About
Hearst Fujingaho | Hearst Digital Japan
Hearst Fujingaho Co., Ltd. and Hearst Digital Japan Co., Ltd. are part of the Hearst group, which comprises leading global companies engaged in diversified media, information, and services. Starting with
Fujingaho
, first published in 1905, we have produced best-in-class content related to fashion, culture, design, food, and weddings through media brands including
ELLE
,
25ans
,
Harper’s Bazaar
, and
Esquire
. In recent years, we have expanded our business beyond media. We currently operate two e-commerce websites: the
ELLE Shop
, and the
Fujingaho Shop
. In 2019, Hearst launched HearstMade, a service that creates client-owned media, and the Hearst Data Solutions, which provides data-driven brand marketing. We will continue to develop our business by combining our long-cultivated expertise in content creation with our deep understanding of the digital sphere and data utilization.
Hearst Fujingaho

About Hearst
Hearst is a leading global, diversified information, services, and media company with operations in 40 countries.
Its major interests include financial services leader Fitch Group; Hearst Health, a group of medical information and services businesses; Hearst Transportation, which includes CAMP Systems International, a major provider of software-as-a-service solutions for managing maintenance of jets and helicopters; ownership in cable television networks such as A&E, HISTORY, Lifetime and ESPN; 33 television stations; 24 daily and 52 weekly newspapers; digital services businesses; and nearly 250 magazines around the world.
Hearst Magazines International, a unit of Hearst Magazines, encompasses more than 200 editions and 150 websites around the world.
Hearst Magazines’ portfolio of more than 25 powerful brands in the U.S. inspires and entertains audiences across all media platforms. Hearst Magazines’ print and digital assets reach nearly 150.3 million readers and site visitors each month — 60% of all millennials and 61% of all Gen Z over the age of 18 (Source: 2021 comScore Multi-Platform © MRI-Simmons (07-21/S21)). The company publishes nearly 260 magazine editions and 200 websites around the world.
Hearst(US)
Executive Team
Representative Director & CEO
Nicolas Floquet
Born in Champagne, Eastern France. After graduating from Emlyon Business School in France, Floquet obtained an MBA from the University of Connecticut in 1995 and came to Japan in 2002 to work for an apparel company. He joined Hachette Fujingaho (now Hearst Fujingaho) in 2004. After serving as CFO, he was appointed managing director in 2007 to engage in general management, with a focus on e-commerce and advertising. He was promoted to COO in 2012, and in 2018 he became representative director and CEO of Hearst Fujingaho Co., Ltd. and Hearst Digital Japan Co., Ltd. He serves as a Visiting Fellow at Seikei University's Institute for a Super-Smart Society from April 2024.
Director (External)
Debi Chirichella
Chirichella became president of Hearst Magazines after serving as its executive vice president, chief financial officer, and director of global operations.
Director (External)
Jonathan Wright
Wright currently serves as president of Hearst Magazines International. He joined Hearst Magazines in 2021.
Japan Leadership
CEO Message
"Welcome to Hearst!”
Please allow me to introduce you to our company, an interesting mix of strong legacy, cultivated through our more than 120 years in Japan, and our innovations in many areas for our readers and our advertisers. We pride ourselves on being a unique blend of Japanese, American, and French tastes in our approach to our lifestyle contents, through a portfolio of media brands from three continents.
The media landscape has changed drastically over the past decade, and our company has evolved from being a magazine publisher to a diversified content provider and multimedia company. It has never been a better time to work in media, which is now an exciting industry of continuous innovations in a world where people consume more quality content every day. The pace of change has never been faster, but an unchanging aspect of our company is that we have remained a passion-driven business for more than a century.
We now produce and distribute entertaining and inspirational content in many formats and fields, from fashion to culture, design to food, beauty to wellness, and many more. Our trusted brands are founded upon decades of editorial expertise and supported by the latest in audience insights and data. Our work for advertisers has expanded to support all stages of the marketing funnel, from building awareness to inducing purchases, offering communications, data, video, and event solutions. We also direct our readers toward shopping for products selected and curated by our editors. Print magazines, digital media, and e-commerce each now account for approximately one-third of our revenue.
As a leader of our times and as a media company that has confronted society with a journalistic spirit since its foundation, we feel a special responsibility. We try to set the standard for sustainability matters, with a special effort on women’s empowerment and environmental issues. We promote consciousness in these matters through our media content and retail products, and we take action toward actively contributing through the sustainability action guidelines outlined in our “Planet Hearst” initiative.
We want our workplace to reflect our strong beliefs, with flexibility and diversity as keywords. We of course hope to provide a workplace where our employees can work with flexibility and comfort, but also one where they can mingle and learn from each other. Another goal we consider important is building a workplace where parents with young children do not have to choose between their careers and their families.
We have entertained, informed, and empowered audiences across Japan since 1905. We are very proud of our illustrious heritage, and we have even bigger plans for the future. We would love for you to be part of them.
Come, and discover what’s next!
Representative Director & CEO
Nicolas Floquet
Access
Directly connected to Exit 12 of Tameike-sanno Station (Tokyo Metro Ginza & Namboku Lines) and Kokkai-gijidomae Station (Tokyo Metro Chiyoda & Marunouchi Lines).
